answer: Because the timing is recorded against the echo challenge, the falcon audit can replay the timber history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 120 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3521 identities would post 1648 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
